admission.justification: The public producer, file storage, lifecycle or native transport owners must preserve this same boundary across their distinct source locations.

applicability: Product-plugin handling of role-agent turn-end and readiness events.
conditions: The host supplies lifecycle events and role start has published the needed subject/parent facts.
exclusions: Developer chat text and native host chat display
Messages via removed earlier orchestration tools
No host polling; no developer-chat parent line; no repeated-event or cross-process durable deduplication claim.

evidence: 17 host-free node decision tests incl. sealed overlap/restart schedules (L117-C1-F06); publish/round-trip tests; checks-attempt4/plugin-turn-ended.log; worker report Attempt 4

statement: A silent role-agent turn end wakes its parent with one four-fact line (role, agent, task, newest report); a return, a permission wait, a developer-chat parent, or a running descendant yields or defers it exactly once.
